summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge by analyzing Soony's confidential launch data and building a general, adaptable recheck-and-act procurement agent product (poller, versioned store, extraction, recompute, supplier actions, approval flow, demo and hand-in materials).
summary.outcome: Data analysis found the Collector's Edition and Standard launch at risk despite the plan saying all ok. A full app was built and deployed (Today/Launch views, routines, supplier emails, Maren sign-off loop, separate demo instance with dry mail, README, demo script), and the branch was pushed through 3468eb8, with 2 further commits (demo script and later) unpushed. Hand-in at 12:00 is pending.

repo: data/ is gitignored and holds confidential portal data, scans and notes; .env holds the portal token, only .env.example is committed
Portal API has only list files, get file and archive.zip, with no webhooks; changes must be detected by polling the file list and comparing SHA-256, since files get replaced under the same name
Team workflow lives in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md; work is on branch jonas/today-flow and Entire checkpoints are pushed along with git push
Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files changed in the session
Demo instance runs on ask-soony-demo.stenglein.dev with dry mail mode (outbox in data/demo/state/dry_outbox.json), controlled via scripts/demo.sh reset|snapshot|stop
ASK_SIGNOFF_SIMULATE=<seconds> auto-approves passed-on escalations as 'simulated for the demo'; ASK_CALL_PROVIDER=dry_run disables real phone calls; the front end polls state every 5 s (POLL_MS)
Push notifications go to every subscribed device, with no per-person routing
Prepared routine proposals must expire when their case is decided and be deduplicated across routines, otherwise approving them fails with 'not an open card'
Shared mailbox sync had a lost-update race that overwrote the action log; fixed by appending under the shared lock
J/K navigation must step row by row over folded groups, and a row must stay highlighted while any case in its group is open
workflow: Subagents were used for large cross-checks (200 order confirmations and 59 scans) and for the sign-off feature; the builder's work was committed only after verifying tests and a restart
Verify UI fixes in a real browser or screenshot (e.g. pressing J ten times and checking highlight)
Costly actions such as real phone calls (about $0.38/min) and real supplier emails need explicit user approval; the demo instance isolates them
Cloudflare tunnel DNS must point to the correct tunnel, otherwise Error 1033 appears

friction: Portal token was initially empty, which blocked data access until the user filled it in
Entire's session ID differed from the SessionStart entry and looked as if hooks had not fired
Four prepared steps failed with 'not an open card' because they were stale
The art book approval record was lost by the mailbox sync race, though the email itself went out
First demo hostname DNS pointed to the wrong tunnel and gave Error 1033
Browser favicon caching kept showing the old yellow icon
Escalations and internal messages originally went nowhere, while the UI claimed 'DC site lead has it now'
Left column omitted waiting steps and the top bar said 'nothing needs you' incorrectly
Launch wording implied the user had to decide a case that was with Maren
Supplier replies cannot be shown on the demo instance, since nothing is really sent
